faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani) Hyderabad Campus for a BFI-BIOME sponsored project position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Junior Research Fellow (JRF). There is a total of 1 vacancy available for this project-based research position in Telangana.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First-class Master's Degree in Pharmacology or Medicinal Chemistry from a recognized university along with a valid GATE, NET, GPAT, DBT, DST, ICMR, or CSIR score.

faq.question: Q4. Is any prior experience preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with prior experience of working with cell-based in vitro studies and hands-on experience in animal handling and dosing will be given preference during shortlisting.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your complete application via email is 15-10-2026. Make sure to send your CV and cover letter well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their detailed curriculum vitae and cover letter via email to the designated official email address provided in the BITS Pilani notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a preliminary shortlisting of candidates based on their resume followed by a telephonic or audio-visual interview, leading to a final online interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The date of the interview for shortlisted candidates is scheduled for 22-10-2026, and the selected candidate is expected to join by 02-11-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can check the official BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus website at www.hyderabad.bits-pilani.ac.in to access complete notification details and further updates.
